items.title: Playwright 1.48 ships built-in flaky-test quarantine
items.summary: Failing tests can now be auto-tagged and re-run in isolation instead of blocking the whole suite, with a report diffing quarantine hits over time.

items.title: New benchmark measures agentic coding tools on real bug reports, not katas
items.summary: Researchers replaced synthetic coding puzzles with 400 real GitHub issues, and ranking shifts noticeably once the tasks stop being toy problems.

items.title: Google publishes internal 'test impact analysis' post-mortem
items.summary: A retrospective on why selective test execution rolled out three times before it stuck, with concrete false-negative numbers from each attempt.

items.title: k6 adds native browser-based Core Web Vitals checks
items.summary: Load tests can now assert on LCP and INP alongside throughput, closing a long-standing gap between performance and UX testing.

items.title: Survey: 61% of QA teams now maintain an internal LLM eval suite
items.summary: The State of QA 2026 survey shows eval-writing overtaking manual exploratory testing as a stated primary duty for the first time.

items.title: GitHub Actions adds per-job carbon estimate in run summaries
items.summary: CI runs now surface an estimated CO2e figure next to duration and cost, sourced from runner region and instance type.

items.title: Cypress and Playwright interoperability layer released as a community project
items.summary: A thin adapter lets teams run existing Cypress custom commands inside a Playwright test runner during migration, rather than a big-bang rewrite.

items.title: Anthropic publishes guidance on evaluating agentic tool-use reliability
items.summary: A practical write-up on building eval harnesses for tool-calling agents, with emphasis on distinguishing flaky tools from flaky models.

items.title: Postman adds contract-testing mode against OpenAPI specs
items.summary: Collections can now be validated against a live OpenAPI schema on every run, failing fast when an endpoint drifts from its spec.

items.title: Why 'shift-left' quietly became 'shift-everywhere' in 2026
items.summary: An essay tracing how testing responsibilities spread across the whole delivery pipeline instead of just moving earlier in it.

items.title: Kubernetes 1.32 stabilizes in-place pod resource resizing
items.summary: Long-running test environments can now have CPU/memory limits adjusted without a pod restart, cutting a common source of E2E test flakiness.

items.title: Testim and Mabl both add 'self-healing' diff explanations
items.summary: Both platforms now show a plain-language reason for why a locator was auto-updated, instead of a silent healing action in the run log.
